From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@clearstreamlabs.com>

Date: 2027-04-11T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Top-up request: increased inference throughput for Q3

Hi David,

Quick note from our ops/AI team — ClearStream is seeing a sustained 3x increase in batch transcription traffic starting mid-July. Based on current forecasts we need an incremental ~200M tokens/month for Jul-Sep (on top of our committed units).

Two asks: can we get (1) a short-term top-up (billed pro-rata) to avoid throttling in July, and (2) a path to co-term this top-up with our Aug 1 renewal so it's cleaner for our finance team? We want to avoid doubling invoices and would prefer credits applied to the renewal invoice if possible.

Also flagging that regulatory requires data residency confirmation if you recommend moving any workload to a Dedicated pool.

I've attached our short request doc with estimated consumption. Can you share quickly what a staged billing vs voucher path would look like and any discounts for committed short-term capacity?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Chen
Director of AI Ops
ClearStream Labs

Subject: Re: Top-up request: increased inference throughput for Q3

Alex — appreciate the heads up and the attachment. Quick read-through and we can support the burst without throttling. Two pragmatic options below (summary; attached a detailed pricing worksheet):

Option A — Immediate pro-rata top-up (fastest) - One-off add of 200M tokens/month, invoiced pro-rata for remainder of current month + monthly invoice thereafter. No long-term commitment. No discount.

Option B — Staged voucher applied to renewal (preferred for finance) - Issue a voucher equal to the forecasted uplift (applies as credit to invoices). Voucher purchased now, applied to invoices Jul–Sep. If purchased before 2027-04-22 we can offer a 7% credit on the voucher purchase. Voucher will be co-termed/rolled into your Aug 1 renewal as a line item per your request.

Option C — Short-term Dedicated burst (if you need guaranteed capacity) - Reserve a small Dedicated pool for Jul–Sep with a 12% discount on token rates in exchange for a short-term amendment (adds a committed capacity line). Requires a Data Processing Addendum and region confirmation for residency.

Operational notes:
- If you want the voucher -> we'll prepare an amendment that applies credits to the Aug 1 renewal invoice so it simplifies PO processing.
- For Dedicated we need to confirm whether EU/US residency is necessary and which cloud region to spin the pool in.
- Attached: rwd_pricing_options_clearstream_20270412.xlsx (breaks down per-token effective rates by option).

Next step: tell me which option you prefer and whether procurement needs a draft SOW/PO template — I can loop in Kimberly for any legal/contract carveouts and Marissa to coordinate CS onboarding for the Dedicated burst.

Best,
David
David Kim

Thanks David — helpful summary. A couple of clarifying points / constraints from finance/procurement: 

- Our renewal is Aug 1 (co-term target). Finance prefers credits applied to the renewal invoice rather than a separate 3-month billing cadence.
- Procurement requires a one-page SOW + invoiceable PO number before we can approve payment; turnaround is usually 7 business days.
- If we go Dedicated, it must be provisioned in us-west-2; we will provide the residency confirmation but need the DPA and any SOC2 evidence as part of the packet.

Bottom line: Option B (voucher applied to renewal) is our preference if you can give the 7% incentive and guarantee the voucher will be visible on the Aug 1 renewal invoice. Also: what happens to any unused voucher balance at renewal — does it roll forward or convert to overage credit?

Maya / Alex — looping Kimberly (Legal) and Marissa (Customer Success) to close the loop and provide the contractual path. Consolidated proposal below — goal is minimal administrative overhead for ClearStream and guaranteed capacity in July: 

Consolidated two-step plan (recommended):
1) Immediate voucher issuance: 50% of the requested uplift (100M tokens/month) issued as a voucher now, applied as a credit across Jul invoice(s). If purchased and signed by 2027-04-22 we will apply a 7% voucher bonus credit. Any unused voucher balance at the Aug 1 renewal can either (A) roll forward for 3 months or (B) be converted to an overage credit at the same effective rate — we'll capture your preference in the amendment.

2) Committed burst reserve for Aug 1–Sep 30 (optional): if you want guaranteed headroom for the full Q3 window we'll add a short-term amendment to reserve a Dedicated pool in us-west-2. Signing the amendment by 2027-04-22 yields a 12% discount on the added committed line and includes a DPA/region residency confirmation. Marissa will coordinate the provisioning cadence if you opt for Dedicated.

Procurement checklist we will support:
- One-page SOW (we will draft)
- Amendment (voucher + co-term instructions) for signature (DocuSign link below)
- Please send PO number to billing@redwood-inference.com after signature

Action items and links:
- DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/clearstream-topup-0427 (amendment + voucher acceptance)
- Draft SOW & pricing worksheet attached: rwd_pricing_options_clearstream_20270412.xlsx
- If you confirm by 2027-04-22 we lock the 7% voucher bonus and the 12% Dedicated discount.
